correctness.rationale: Exact projection and normalized retraction give F(theta). Symbolically checked rational derivative identities provide parameter-uniform positive polynomial signs and monotonicity. Strict amplitude descent proves global convergence, reciprocal asymptotic proves the critical rate (with finite termination excluded), implicit monotonicity plus derivative positivity proves attraction, and endpoint expansions prove both asymptotic laws. Checker successfully replays identities; finite tests are supplemental.
